core_obligations: Smooth implies power series (proof lines 4383-4402): if the functor of S over R is smooth then apply the lifting property to the surjection T/m_T^2 -> T/(m_R T + m_T^2) and successively to the higher quotients, obtaining maps f_n : S -> T/m_T^n; their limit is a local R-algebra map f : S -> T which induces an isomorphism on relative cotangent spaces by construction, hence is surjective.

Produce a section (proof lines 4402-4408): choosing preimages y_i in S of the variables X_i under f and using that T is a power series ring gives a local R-algebra map s : T -> S with f composed with s the identity, so s is injective, and since s induces an isomorphism on relative cotangent spaces it is also surjective, whence f and s are isomorphisms.

Power series implies smooth (proof lines 4408-4394 part one): conversely, if S = R[[x_1, ..., x_n]] and a solid lifting diagram is given, choose elements b_i of B mapping to the images of the x_i in A; the b_i lie in the maximal ideal of B, so there is a unique R-algebra map R[[x_1, ..., x_n]] -> B sending x_i to b_i, which is the required dotted arrow, and smoothness follows from the lifting reformulation.
proof_roadmap: Translate smoothness into the lifting property for surjections of Artinian algebras.
In the nontrivial direction lift the mod-square map successively to obtain a surjective map onto the power series ring and construct a section, then compare cotangent spaces to get an isomorphism.
In the trivial direction build the dotted arrow from the choice of lifts of the images of the variables.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a ring map R -> S in the completed category the induced morphism of formal spectra is smooth exactly when S is a power series ring over R (statement lines 2241-2247). The proof (proof lines 2249-2319) translates smoothness into a lifting property, constructs in the nontrivial direction a surjective map onto the power series ring together with a section and compares relative cotangent spaces, and in the other direction builds the dotted arrow from lifts of the images of the variables. H3: two independent directions with genuine constructions on both sides, written out in full.
